description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the HRWebApp database layer from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, including JDBC driver, connection configuration, SQL syntax, and Oracle-specific features (data types, sequences, stored procedures/functions, operators).
tasks.reason: User requested migration of the application database from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server to modernize the data tier and run on a managed Azure database service.
tasks.requirements: Replace Oracle JDBC driver (ojdbc) and connection URLs with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver and Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server connection settings. Convert all Oracle-specific SQL (data types, sequences, ROWNUM/DUAL, NVL/DECODE, stored procedures, functions, triggers) found in Java sources and SQL/resource files to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Preserve existing application behavior for all HR features. Use coding_notes.md guidance if present. Authentication to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server should default to Microsoft Entra ID Managed Identity.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: Ensure the modernized application has no known dependency vulnerabilities after the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime environment established by previous tasks (Java 1.8). Build tool: Maven.
